text_target: This is my room.
text_native: C'est ma chambre.

text_target: I live in a small flat.
text_native: J'habite dans un petit appartement.

text_target: The door is open.
text_native: La porte est ouverte.

text_target: My keys are on the table.
text_native: Mes clés sont sur la table.

text_target: I like my new sofa.
text_native: J'aime bien mon nouveau canapé.

text_target: Where is the remote control?
text_native: Où est la télécommande ?

text_target: Turn on the light, please.
text_native: Allume la lumière, s'il te plaît.

text_target: I want a cup of coffee.
text_native: Je veux une tasse de café.

text_target: The milk is in the fridge.
text_native: Le lait est dans le frigo.

text_target: I am cooking dinner now.
text_native: Je cuisine le dîner en ce moment.

text_target: We eat at seven o'clock.
text_native: On mange à sept heures.

text_target: Can you wash these dishes?
text_native: Tu peux faire cette vaisselle ?

text_target: My clothes are in the wash.
text_native: Mes vêtements sont à la machine.

text_target: I need to clean the bathroom.
text_native: Il faut que je nettoie la salle de bains.

text_target: The cat is sleeping on the bed.
phonetic: /ðə kæt ɪz ˈsliːpɪŋ ɑːn ðə bɛd/
text_native: Le chat dort sur le lit.

text_target: I charge my phone every night.
text_native: Je charge mon téléphone tous les soirs.

text_target: Let's watch a film tonight.
text_native: On se regarde un film ce soir ?

text_target: I usually go to bed at ten.
phonetic: /aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli goʊ tuː bɛd æt tɛn/
text_native: D'habitude je vais me coucher à dix heures.

text_target: Don't forget to lock the front door.
phonetic: /doʊnt fərˈɡɛt tuː lɑːk ðə frʌnt dɔːr/
text_native: N'oublie pas de fermer la porte d'entrée à clé.

text_target: I am so tired, I am going to sleep.
phonetic: /aɪ æm soʊ ˈtaɪərd, aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː sliːp/
text_native: Je suis trop fatigué, je vais dormir.
